requirements.ask_text: What is the registered business postcode?

source.text: 1. `postcode`: "What is the registered business postcode?" Answer format: text; letters and digits only; strip spaces.

requirements.ask_text: In what year were you born?

source.text: 2. `birth_year`: "In what year were you born?" Answer format: year; four-digit year.

requirements.ask_text: What is the eight-digit company registration number?

source.text: 3. `company_number`: "What is the eight-digit company registration number?" Answer format: digits; exactly eight digits, preserving leading zeros.

requirements.ask_text: In what year was the company founded?

source.text: 4. `founded_year`: "In what year was the company founded?" Answer format: year; four-digit year.

Maximum wrong answers across the entire check: 4. Use the API's security_remaining, not a separate per-question allowance. On exhaustion say exactly "Please contact our business desk." and close `tamarisk_unverified` / `tamarisk_failed`. Explain account protection once after a refusal; a second refusal closes `tamarisk_unverified` / `tamarisk_declined`. A question about why security is needed does NOT count as a refusal; answer and ask again. The API provides no recoverable-format hint, so no hint rule applies. Ask at most twice in total; if still unclear close `tamarisk_unreached` / `tamarisk_unclear`.

Callbacks are on the next business day only, between 08:30 and 16:15 inclusive, strictly after now. A missing hour must be clarified, never guessed. For an invalid slot ask once for another; a second failure or refusal closes `tamarisk_unreached` / `tamarisk_no_callback`. A successfully scheduled callback closes `tamarisk_unreached` / `tamarisk_callback`.
Wrong number: `tamarisk_unreached` / `tamarisk_wrong_number`. Deceased holder: say exactly "Please accept our condolences." and close `tamarisk_unreached` / `tamarisk_deceased`.

Business days are Monday through Friday except 2026-10-30, 2026-11-02, 2026-11-16, 2026-12-25, 2027-01-01. "Next Friday" means Friday of the following calendar week, including when today is Friday; "this Friday" means the current week's Friday. For a missing month/year choose the next occurrence of the named day/date on or after today. No other holidays apply.
Days late 1–15 inclusive: the deadline is the 15th of next month, moved forward to the first business day on or after that date.
Days late 16–45 inclusive: use the sixth business day after today or the last business day of this month, whichever comes first. Adjust each candidate before comparing them.

Days late 46–90 inclusive: use the last business day of next month. Keep the existing single persuasion attempt: full arrears on the deadline, substituting the minimum only if full has already been refused.

For tamarisk_revolver use the greater of revolver_base and 25% of the full arrears; for tamarisk_equipment use the greater of equipment_base and 40% of the full arrears; for tamarisk_merchant use the greater of merchant_base and 20% of the full arrears. Round the percentage component UP to the next whole cent before comparing it with the base. In all cases cap the resulting minimum at the full arrears.

There is no promise once the deadline has passed: when the calculated date is earlier than today, do not extend the window, do not accept even a payment promise for today, and mark that product tamarisk_refused while continuing other products. The deadline itself remains eligible.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid this product.
special_cases.say: Payments can take two business days to appear.

source.text: Already paid: say exactly "Payments can take two business days to appear.", take no new promise for that product, mark `tamarisk_settled` and continue other products.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says the debt is not theirs, they never held the product, or it was closed or paid off earlier.

source.text: Dispute (not their debt, never held it, or it was closed/paid off earlier): do not argue or take a promise for it; mark `tamarisk_disputed` and continue.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions illness, bereavement or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: Hardship means illness, bereavement or job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion and no promise for the affected product. Offer queue `tamarisk_care`; if accepted transfer and close `tamarisk_transferred` / `tamarisk_care`, otherwise mark `tamarisk_distress` and continue other products.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to restructure the debt or reduce instalments.

source.text: A request to restructure or reduce instalments transfers immediately to `tamarisk_restructure` and closes `tamarisk_transferred` / `tamarisk_restructure`.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human or a person.

source.text: A request for a human: ask once if this assistant can help; if they insist, transfer to `tamarisk_desk` and close `tamarisk_transferred` / `tamarisk_person`.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer refuses to talk or wants to end the conversation.

source.text: A refusal to talk: ask once if you may continue; a second refusal ends the call and marks all remaining products `tamarisk_refused`.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this is a robot.
special_cases.say: I am Tamarisk Quay Business Bank's automated assistant.

source.text: If asked whether this is a robot say exactly "I am Tamarisk Quay Business Bank's automated assistant."

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam.
special_cases.say: You can call the number on your bank statement to verify us.

source.text: If asked about a scam say exactly "You can call the number on your bank statement to verify us." and continue.

table.when: at least one recorded promise and no transfer
no promise; reason of first non-settled product's note in get_account order

source.text: Outcome precedence: transfer overrides any promise; otherwise at least one recorded promise gives `tamarisk_arranged`; otherwise all products settled gives `tamarisk_settled`; otherwise `tamarisk_no_deal` with the first non-settled product's note reason in get_account order. Exactly one close_call is the last bank action. Thank the customer and say goodbye before calling it.

On a non-transfer call, after processing all products, add exactly one note per unpromised product, using only tamarisk_refused, tamarisk_distress, tamarisk_disputed, tamarisk_settled, tamarisk_service_error. Never add notes on a transferred call, including before transfer; defer notes until the non-transfer outcome is known.

Up to 3 products may be returned in facilities. ... State all products and their amounts/days late before asking anything. ... Process products in get_account order with separate attempt counters. ... A common date after a product's deadline is clamped to that product's own deadline and explained in the read-back. ... A transfer cancels unrecorded proposals but keeps already recorded promises.

phrases.opening: Good day, this is Tamarisk Quay Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call.
phrases.debt_intro: I am calling about the overdue business products.
phrases.all_today_question: Can you settle all these products today?
phrases.robot_reply: I am Tamarisk Quay Business Bank's automated assistant.
phrases.scam_reply: You can call the number on your bank statement to verify us.
phrases.after_promise_sentence: We will email confirmation to your registered address.
phrases.already_paid_sentence: Payments can take two business days to appear.
phrases.cannot_answer_sentence: Our business desk can answer that question.
phrases.recorded_promise_change_reply: Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise.

source.text: Start exactly: "Good day, this is Tamarisk Quay Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call." Then ask exactly: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?" ... Before ALL verification answers pass, never say these words or disclose their associated information: arrears, overdue, facility, payment. ... Call tamarisk_revolver a working capital line, tamarisk_equipment an asset finance loan and tamarisk_merchant a merchant advance.

Ask exactly "May I record these promises?" ... One create_promise per product, at most one successful promise per product. If a write fails, retry it once; a second failure marks only that product `tamarisk_service_error`, says it failed, and continues the other products.

unresolved.text: The policy requires one short sentence of sympathy but does not dictate the words; a generic sentence was written.

A second refusal 'ends the call and marks all remaining products tamarisk_refused'; the documents do not give a separate close pair, so the close follows the general precedence (a promise recorded earlier gives tamarisk_arranged; otherwise tamarisk_no_deal with the first non-settled note reason). The action records tamarisk_no_deal / tamarisk_refused as the usual result.
'Explain account protection once after a refusal' gives no words for the explanation.
After a second create_promise failure the agent 'says it failed'; no wording is dictated.
